<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Divine Premonition](/Classes.aspx?ID=65)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 28

**Class** Exemplar
</column>

---

A sense of the flow of fate allows you to respond to danger with uncanny alacrity. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.
name: Divine Premonition
